blocks.text: Ada Wrenhollow
Collections Project Lead
Profile
Leads small catalog migrations and trains staff to review new records.
Selected work: view the project brief.
Experience
Rowan Lantern Archive	2022 - Present
Planned a move from shelf lists to a shared catalog.
Compared each imported batch with the original accession records.
Created a reference sheet for uncertain attributions.
Selected projects
Collection inventory	2019 - 2021
Mapped 14 storage zones with the registrar and drew a shelf diagram for each room.
Reconciled labels against the intake register. Where a recorded number matched two objects, kept both records open for review.
Observed the time required to record each box and planned the remaining shifts around access to the storage rooms.
Created a batch sheet with fields for room, shelf, accession number, condition note, and review initials.
Set aside items with detached labels until the registrar could compare the acquisition photographs.
Selected projects
Catalog review	2021 - 2023
Wrote instructions for normalizing date ranges and materials while preserving the wording from the original label.
Separated temporary object identifiers from accession numbers before the first import.
Worked with the reading room team to identify which legacy fields researchers searched most often.
Compared a sample of printed finding aids against the imported records and logged each discrepancy.
Prepared a handoff checklist covering duplicate items, incomplete descriptions, and scanned attachments.
Access and training	2023 - Present
Built a set of practice records for new reviewers and paired each record with a worked example.
Led review sessions with staff from three departments and collected questions for the field guide.
Created a sign-off sheet for edits that needed the registrar and collections manager to agree.
Set up a short weekly report covering open batches, unresolved location changes, and records awaiting photographs.
Transferred the review schedule to the permanent team and ran the next week's audit alongside them.
